correctness.rationale: For uniform perfect matching on even N, b specified disjoint edges have probability product_{j=0}^{b-1}(N-(2j+1))^(-1). A coloured cycle core with k directed successor path segments has N^k+O(N^(k-1)) injective placements and k required matching edges, so its unlabelled mean tends to 1/|Aut H|. Overlapping distinct cycles create excess >=1, giving O(N^-1) factorial-moment terms; disjoint selections factor, yielding joint independent Poisson limits. Rare nearby cycles and abundant generic 3-regular coloured rooted trees permit bounded-degree effective Hanf locality to reduce every fixed FO sentence to finite truncated core counts; conversely finite cycle-embedding formulas define threshold events asymptotically. Rational means imply probabilities in Q[e^-1/D]; the infinitely many independent length-l chord indicators give dense finite Boolean-algebra probabilities. Independent exhaustive n=8,10 matching tests verified adjacent and distance-two chord means and mixed moments. Hanf theorem and general-n convergence are analytical, not finite-check results.
residual_risks: Hanf locality is used as an external standard theorem; a formal proof certificate for it is not supplied
